name: Medicine
description:
You've studied the ways of the healers of Kerok.

Whenever you cause a creature to gain Endurance, the creature gains 1 additional Endurance. This additional Endurance increases by 1 for every 5 points you have in HEART.

Whenever you roll Aid to attempt to diagnose or treat an illness or wound, the roll is favored.

Describe your medical training.
